production.note: US model years. Edmunds lists the DBS model years 2009, 2011, 2012 and then 2022-2023 (the later DBS Superleggera era); its 2008 page has no 2008 cars, and its 2010 specs page (edmunds-dbs-2010) lists the 2010 coupe at '510 hp @ 6,500 rpm'. US News (usnews-dbs-2009) reviews the car 'when the 2009 DBS was new'; AutoGuide (autoguide-dbs-2009, Colum Wood, 25 February 2009) reviews the 2009 car. Edmunds' 2013 DB9 review (edmunds-db9-2013-review-dbs) calls the DBS 'discontinued'. Aston's release (jalopnik-dbs-release-2007): 'Deliveries of the DBS are expected to commence during quarter one 2008'. UK model years were MY2008-MY2013 per AstonMartins.com (enthusiast site, not cited).

body.note: 2+2 coupe. The DBS Volante is sold under its own name and is not part of this record. Not to be confused with the 1967-1972 DBS or the 2019-on DBS Superleggera.

displacementL.note: 5,935 cc (Aston: '5935cc V12'). Aston calls it 6.0-litre ('6.0-litre V12'); the rounded cc figure is used.

aspiration.note: '6.0-litre V12' with no turbocharger or supercharger mentioned.

transmission.note: 'Available with two transmissions -- a six-speed manual transmission or a 'Touchtronic 2' six-speed with an electronic shift-by-wire control system'. Launch cars were manual only; the automatic became optional in late 2008 per AstonMartins.com (enthusiast site, not cited).

powerHp.note: Quote (Aston Martin release reproduced by Jalopnik): "Max power: 380kW (510bhp/517 PS) at 6500rpm". 517 PS x 0.98632 = 509.9 hp, rounded to 510. US figures agree: Edmunds 2010 '510 hp @ 6,500 rpm' (edmunds-dbs-2010), US News 'a 510-horsepower V12 engine' (usnews-dbs-2009). No rating change during the run.

weightLb.note: Step 1 of the weight order (manufacturer figure for the launch car, which was manual only, i.e. the standard car). Quote (Aston Martin release reproduced by Jalopnik): "Weight: 1695kg (3737lb)". 1,695 kg x 2.20462 = 3,736.8 lb, rounded to 3,737, as Aston printed. AstonMartins.com (enthusiast site, not cited): 'Kerb Weight (unladen mass): 1695 kg (manual), 1740 kg (auto)'. AutoGuide (autoguide-dbs-2009): 'At 3,737 lbs'.

discrepancies.reason: Edmunds lists 'Curb Weight: 4,089 lbs.' (about 1,855 kg) identically for the manual and automatic coupe; this matches no Aston coupe figure (1,695 kg manual per Aston; 1,740 kg auto per AstonMartins.com, not cited) and is likely a Volante or database error.
discrepancies.resolution: Used Aston's 1,695 kg for the manual coupe.
